capabilities: collaborate on notes in real time with per-person cursors and character-level merge
share edits live in canvases, bases, properties and community Kanban and Excalidraw content
sync shared folders across devices, merging offline changes and keeping conflict copies
encrypt content on the device before sending so the server stores only ciphertext
share attachments on paid plans with per-plan storage limits
extras: Freemium: the plugin is free but the hosted service is paid ($5/mo Personal up to $18/seat/mo Small Business); free plan is text-only sync with no attachment storage. The self-run server is a licensed image that is not yet available. Source-available under PolyForm Shield License 1.0.0 with a build-verification script; the security model is documented separately in docs/security-model.md. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for multiple people to edit shared notes together in real time on a server that cannot read the content.

relations.evidence: Kanban boards made with the community Kanban plugin
Excalidraw drawings made with the community Excalidraw plugin, live

requires.name: nectenda.com paid plans for attachment storage

summary: End-to-end encrypted real-time collaboration plugin that syncs shared folders with live cursors, offline editing and conflict copies.
